name: interop-gateway-monorepo
description: Monorepo for interop-gateway (SMART on FHIR connectivity + HL7v2/CDA translation) and its browser demo

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core -w packages/protocol -w packages/secrets -w packages/connector -w packages/engine -w packages/mcp -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core -w packages/protocol -w packages/secrets -w packages/connector -w packages/engine -w packages/mcp -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core -w packages/protocol -w packages/secrets -w packages/connector -w packages/engine -w packages/mcp -w client
